# Area Worker — Runner

<h1 align="center">
  AREA-WORKER - 2025<br>

</h1>

This repository implements the "Area" workflow runner used to execute
workflow jobs. The source is TypeScript and can run locally, in Docker
or as ephemeral Kubernetes jobs ( KinD / cluster ). See the `docs/`
directory for build, run and deployment instructions.

- Quick start: see `docs/README.md`
- Deployment: see `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`

If you contribute, please follow the project README and tests before
opening a PR.
